find_all_duplicates_500.root_cause: MongoDB Atlas shared tier (M0/M2/M5) does not support the allowDiskUse option for aggregation pipelines. When the aggregation exceeds the 100MB memory limit, it fails with 'QueryExceededMemoryLimitNoDiskUseAllowed' error.
find_all_duplicates_500.code_status: CORRECT - allowDiskUse=True is properly added at lines 1540 and 1558 in candidates.py
find_all_duplicates_500.reproduction: Call GET /api/candidate-bank/find-all-duplicates with admin auth on a database with 112K+ candidates
mitigation_options: 1. Upgrade MongoDB Atlas to M10+ dedicated cluster (supports allowDiskUse)
2. Rewrite aggregation to use $sample stage to limit documents processed
3. Add pagination to process duplicates in batches
4. Create indexes on email and phone_normalized fields to reduce memory usage
